displayName: Guitar Coach API - instance not ready

documentation.content: The /health/ready uptime check has failed. Check Cloud Run logs for the failing dependency (memory/disk/database/redis/rabbitmq) — HealthController's readiness checks log full detail server-side (see src/health/indicators/). Requires an Uptime Check resource named guitar-coach-api-ready to already exist (see docs/monitoring/README.md). NOTE: the uptime-check alerting condition JSON shape below is unverified against a live policy — if `gcloud alpha monitoring policies create` rejects it, recreate this specific alert via the Cloud Console's Uptime Check UI instead (it offers a one-click 'Create Alerting Policy' action scoped correctly to the check) and skip applying this file.
